method.title: Make the chocolate sponge cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line a 20-22 cm round cake pan.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.

Add the eggs, milk, hot coffee, and oil, and mix until the batter is smooth. The batter will be very loose and liquid, but don’t panic and trust the process! This is what creates the incredibly moist texture.
Bake for approximately 40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Let the cake cool completely before carefully slicing it in half horizontally.

method.title: Prepare the chocolate mousse
steps: Bring the milk and instant coffee to a gentle boil.
Pour the hot coffee milk over the chopped dark chocolate and let it sit for a minute before stirring until completely smooth.
Whip the heavy cream until soft peaks form.
Once the chocolate mixture has cooled slightly, gently fold in the whipped cream until you have a smooth and airy mousse.

method.title: Assemble the cake
steps: Prepare the same cake pan as you baked the cake in with lining baking paper or plastic film all aorund the edges of the pan (you can also use a pastry ring if you have one).
Place the first sponge layer inside of the pan.

Put a few tablespoons of chocolate mousse to the side. Pour the rest of the chocolate mousse evenly over the sponge, then place the second cake layer on top. (Note: if the chocolate mousse is too loose to place the second layer of sponge cake on, let it cool in the fridge before placing it ontop).
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, to allow the mousse to fully set.

method.title: Decorate and serve
steps: Spread a thin layer of the leftover mousse on top of the cake.
Finish with a light dusting of cocoa powder, slice, and enjoy a luxurious little piece of French café culture in your own kitchen!☕🍫
